input.prompt: Inside the vessel now, the camera aims straight up as the dark scissor lift carries the exact same four pale-grey-suited researchers vertically upward through a vast sealed matte-black interior shaft; all four stay planted on the platform the whole time. Towering black striated walls completely surround the frame on every side, converging toward a distant pale glowing ceiling that hangs far above and stays remote, emphasizing enormous scale. The world below has fallen away; only the dark ribbed interior fills every edge of the frame from the first second to the last. Camera and lift travel together in one smooth continuous ascent. Desaturated green-grey 35mm grade, faint interior haze catching the pale glow from above, low contrast, silent awe. Audio: soft air-pressure hush, faint lift motor echoing.
